generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Sample from a per-column pool of 8-30 distinct values; 10% of rows get a near-variant (case change, leading/trailing space, or one-character edit) of a pool value; 5-30% NULL only if column is nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Sample from a per-column pool of 8-30 distinct human-readable names; 10% near-variants (case/space); 5-30% NULL only if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_small: Sample uniformly from the observed integer range; include boundary values min, min+1, max-1, max; 5-30% NULL only if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_season: Sample from {2014..2022} with boundary emphasis on 2018,2019,2020,2021,2022; 5-30% NULL only if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.date_iso: Sample dates uniformly in [2020-08-01, 2021-06-30] formatted %Y-%m-%d; include boundary dates 2020-08-08 and 2021-06-30 and one day on each side; 5-30% NULL only if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.enum_short: Sample uniformly from the column's enum list; 5-30% NULL only if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.foreign_key: With probability 0.85 copy a value from the parent column; with probability 0.15 emit a fresh unmatched value (or NULL if nullable) to create parent rows without children and child rows with NULL FK.
generic_sampling_rules.primary_key_text: Sample distinct values from the column pool; never NULL; ensure at least one parent row has no child rows.

dependencies.note: FK; 15% of child rows get unmatched or NULL Div to create parent rows without children and child rows with NULL FK.

semantic_rules_and_formulas.formula: FTR = 'H' OR FTR = 'h' OR FTR = 'D' OR FTR = 'd' OR FTR = 'A' OR FTR = 'a'
FTHG = FTAG OR FTHG = FTAG + 1 OR FTHG = FTAG - 1 OR FTHG + FTAG BETWEEN 9 AND 11
semantic_rules_and_formulas.condition: FTHG IS NOT NULL AND FTAG IS NOT NULL
semantic_rules_and_formulas.evidence: boundary emphasis on total goals 9,10,11 and equal/one-step pairs

supporting_evidence.FTHG_range: observed FTHG distinct 10, values 0..8 in sample
supporting_evidence.FTAG_range: observed FTAG distinct 9, values 0..7 in sample
supporting_evidence.FTR_enum: observed FTR distinct 3 with values A, D, H and case variants in targets
supporting_evidence.season_range: observed season distinct 16, boundary values 2018..2022 in targets
supporting_evidence.FK_join: matchs.Div references divisions.division; unmatched_join_rows pattern requires parent rows without children and child rows with NULL FK
supporting_evidence.null_shares: null_in_count_column patterns on matchs.Div, matchs.FTR, matchs.HomeTeam target 5-30% NULL share

uncertainty.FTHG_FTAG_formula: The combined boundary rule is a sampling emphasis, not a strict constraint; it is stated with a condition so NULL operands are not constrained.
uncertainty.divisions_country: Country pool is larger than the 8 shown values; near-variants of England/Greece are targeted but other countries are sampled freely.
uncertainty.matchs_size: 230 rows per instance is chosen to stay within the 1-230 cap and below the original 123404 rows while allowing all variations to occur.
